skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Gate 3 — Profile the entity, then interview the user' is the only inputs list and is Mosofin-shaped; there is no upload-path checklist, so payment history (for 'Step 2' days-to-pay), 12 months of cash (for the 'Step 3' anniversary scan) and payroll pay dates are never requested.

SKILL.md 'Step 2 — Forecast cash receipts' gives no rule for collection timing when payment history is absent; only 'Edge Cases', 'A days-to-pay derived from too few invoices', mentions 'a stated assumption', and it does not say how to treat overdue invoices.
SKILL.md 'Gate 3' says never default 'the payroll amounts' but gives no rule when the register has no pay date or frequency and disagrees with the bank (53,902 vs 52,310).
SKILL.md 'Step 5 — Flag liquidity risks' requires stating whether the floor is a covenant or a management preference, but the intake row 'Minimum cash threshold / covenant' does not ask which.
sample_defects: payroll_register_2025-09.csv has no pay date or period column and nets to 53,902, while the bank statement shows two runs of 52,310; the 1,592 gap is unexplained, and the key says 'two payroll runs a month' without saying which amount.
No customer payment history or invoice-to-receipt links are supplied, so the skill's central method (derived days-to-pay) cannot be exercised; receipts can only be timed by assumption.

No new sales, purchases or tax dates are supplied, so receipts stop after week 4 and the forecast never approaches the 250,000 floor (low 1,083,592); the floor and the liquidity-risk steps are untested.

term_loan_agreement_summary.md says 5,000 a month plus interest at 5.7%; the statement's 6,900 implies interest of 1,900, i.e. a balance near 1,900 x 12 / 0.057 = 400,000, which nothing else in the set confirms.
